rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something aesthetically pleasing or artistically well-designed.

example.english: The design of this lamp is very aesthetic.
example.traditional: 呢盞燈設計得好有美感。
example.jyutping: ne1 zaan2 dang1 cit3 gai3 dak1 hou2 jau5 mei5 gam2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is specifically on an object's pleasing or presentable appearance.

example.english: Arranging the books this way makes the whole bookshelf much more aesthetic.
example.traditional: 咁樣擺啲書，成個書架美觀好多。
example.jyutping: gam3 joeng2 baai2 di1 syu1 sing4 go3 syu1 gaa2 mei5 gun1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this mainly in written compounds about aesthetic standards, taste, or artistic judgment.

example.traditional: 每個人嘅審美標準都唔同。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 jan4 ge3 sam2 mei5 biu1 zeon2 dou1 m4 tung4
